# StationeersLua 0.2.3 fallback snapshot

This directory contains the Lua editor metadata shipped with
`orbitalfoundrymoddingcrew.stationeers-lua` version `0.2.3`.

It is used only as a bundled fallback when the StationeersLua extension is not
installed. When that extension is installed, Stationeers Toolkit uses its
active `library` directory instead, so newer API declarations are picked up
automatically. The Toolkit-specific overlay remains separate.

The snapshot is distributed under the upstream extension's MIT licence. See
the repository `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` for attribution details.
